text: A token is a unit of text represented by an integer. A tokenizer maps text to token IDs and can decode IDs back to text.
Training begins with randomly initialized weights. Next token prediction compares a prediction with the following token.
A validation set helps select experiments. A held-out test set should remain separate from training and tokenizer fitting.
Gradient descent updates parameters using derivatives of a loss. Adam stores moving estimates of first and second moments.
An attention layer combines information from earlier tokens. A causal mask prevents a position from reading future tokens.
A checkpoint stores model parameters and optimizer states. Reproducible continuation also needs random states and data sampling state.
Supervised fine tuning learns from prompt and answer pairs. The prompt is context, while only assistant answer tokens receive loss.
Preference training compares a chosen answer with a rejected answer for the same prompt. A frozen reference anchors the comparison.
Evaluation records the dataset, tokenizer and decoding settings. A lower training loss alone does not demonstrate useful capability.
A deployment program loads weights and a tokenizer in a new process. A tiny smoke model may generate meaningless text.
Unified memory is shared by applications and the operating system. Memory estimates must include more than model weights.
Measure stable throughput before planning a larger experiment. Small smoke timings cannot predict long training on a laptop.
模型从随机权重开始训练。数据、分词、预训练、后训练、评测与部署应保留可核查的记录。
研究工作室区分教学演示、工程验证和模型能力。没有运行的实验不会填入虚构结果。
Data licenses and code licenses are separate. A source manifest records permission, document groups and content hashes.
An experiment changes one factor when possible. Record exact architecture and vocabulary size rather than only a rounded model name.
